title: Ichor / Orange / Red Tower Skips
instructions:
Using Jump Tech you can skip all floors beyond the first/ground level in every tower in the Rainy zone.

This allows you to skip directly to the end, backwards, entering through the return exit of each tower.
notes: The Red Tower does not require Jump Tech to be skipped.
